Name: Narrator
Dialog: First, there was Football X-7, then Hockey Z-9, but there was an obvious alphanumeric gap between them, so get ready for...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Croquet Y-8!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Huh. Finally the opportunity to show off my mad mallet skills!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: If opportunity doesn't knock, build a door. Or a hoop with a portal.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Fine, but we're doin' Demolition Derby G-48 tomorrow!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, you guys seen Perry?

Name: The gang (including Ferb)
Dialog: In the house.

Name: Buford
Dialog: What's next? Stacy shows up and asks, "Whatcha doin'?"

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) Perry? Perry, where are you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: There you are, my monotreme mon ami.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: It's just a hat, Carl. Why is it just a hat? Do you think he's invisible?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Then wouldn't his hat be floating?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Or maybe he's a ghost.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Well, the hat would still be floating, right?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: They can't interact with the material world, Carl. Use your head!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Alright, Jeremy. Perry and I are all ears. I mean, we're not like all ears. (chuckling) I mean, imagine if we were all ears! Just covered in ears! Like, we can hear out of our elbows! (chuckles, whispers to herself) Candace, you're weird! (out loud, to Jeremy) So what's the sitch?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I need you and Perry for a summer school project for college credit. It's a zoology course.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (looking out the window) Uh-huh, great. A documentary about zoo college.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: It's a day in the life of an exotic animal, and Perry's the most exotic animal I know. So it's you and me documenting Perry all afternoon.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (still looking out the window) Great, sounds like a plan. I'm in.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Are you sure, Candace, 'cause it looks like you may wanna bust your brothers.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No-n-no-no, I can multitask. I can bust the boys while we document Perry. No prob.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Great. Just need some assistance with this equipment from the car. (exits)

Name: Candace
Dialog: You got it! Assistant/producer/girlfriend at your service! (she puts Perry back in his bed) All right, Perry, stay put. Don't do much. Y'know, like you usually don't do.

Name: Jeremy's voice
Dialog: Documenting Perry's life all afternoon... afternoon... afternoon...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) Places, people, places!

Name: Candace
Dialog: All right, Perry. Let's do this!

Name: Major Monogram and Carl
Dialog: Phew!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Thank goodness you're here, Agent P! What kept you?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, you had to use an emergency Perry-bot as a decoy.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Aren't you a little concerned, sir, about all the previous models being recalled due to mechanical failure?

Name: Carl
Dialog: I estimate you got about three hours, give or take, before your bot goes smoke, boom, spaghetti.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Great googly moogly! That would blow your cover with your host family!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, I'll keep it brief. Doof is getting into some farm-related shenanigans, and no good has ever come from a mad scientist taking up animal husbandry. Go get him, Agent P!

Name: Carl
Dialog: In less than three hours!

Name: Echo
Dialog: Three hours! Three hours!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, is that why I signed an invoice for an echo machine?

Name: Echo
Dialog: Machine? Machine?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen, muffled) Welcome, Perry the Platy— Off, off! (A pile of sheep uncover Doof dressed as a shepherd.) I bet you're wondering why I'm depressed as a traditional Drusselstinian shepherd, right? Well, that's because sheep are a part of my latest dastardly plan! Also, I've started taking up knitting. I made this adorable sweater for you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The stitching took twice as long as the online tutorial said it would, but... Uh, it's a little big on you, but we can fix that.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (laughs) There you go, much better. Now you look like an adorable duck-billed baby. A trapped, adorable duck-billed baby. That's you. (tickles him) Coochie-coochie-coo! Ah, yes, the eternal question, Perry the Platypus, do you even sheep, bro?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) When I was a lad, I had trouble sleeping, so my parents told me to try counting sheep...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (cont'd) ...which is weird and not helpful.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) I mean it's not as weird as counting counter-topped whittling crabs to get rid of leg cramps, but still, you get the idea. Granted we had a lot of sheep for accounting purposes, but it just never really worked for me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But counting sheep does work for a lot of people. Hence, and behold, the thing that you're already beholding, my Go-to-Sheep-inator! Lookit, Perry the Platypus, this is my favorite part. The inator rehydrates sheep from a packet of dehydrated sheep that I ordered off of a Drusselstinian website.

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Dehydrated Sheep! Just add water and watch them grow! It's fun, it's easy, and profitable!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: My plan is to give everyone all the sheep they can count, putting all of Danville to sleep, allowing me to take over the... What? What? You're giving me that look. You no likey? Y'know, they can't all be gems, Perry the Platypus. (sighs) You really know how to take the wind out of a guy's sails, you know that?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, what? No! The scheme wasn't that bad!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, I knitted that!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No fair! You distracted me with implied criticism! Aha! (he pushes the button activating the inator) Count the sheep, Perry the Platypus! Count the sheep and go to sleep...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Count the she— Whoa!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, this is an unexpected escalation. Ride 'em, sheep boy!

Name: Perry-Bot
Dialog: (chatters)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Ooh, and apparently, monotremes chitter every ten seconds. (to Candace) Mark that down.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, hungry little guy? Let's get some footage of Perry eating. (Pull out to reveal Candace not there.) Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Gotta call Mom!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, where are they?!

Name: Echo
Dialog: They?! They?!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace? Hey, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, yeah, yeah, yeah. I'll be right there.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I need help finding his food.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, right. Food. Yeah, he likes that. I'm coming!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sorry, Jeremy, I got distracted. I know. Let's up the production value. Come here, Perry, it's showtime! (pours the food into the dish) I got this multitasking thing down. (She looks out the window, but the food falls onto the floor, missing the dish. The Perry-bot dives into the food.)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: A well-balanced diet is vital to the health of any semiaquatic mammal.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I don't think he likes it! Do all platypi do that, or is that a Perry thing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (spying on the backyard through binoculars) No, platypuses don't do much.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Perry, wait up! Candace?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You got this, Jeremy!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Get back here!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (activating the inator) Hey, Perry the Platypus, did you know that the plural of "sheep" is also "sheep"? Isn't that boring? What about "sheeps", or "sheepuses", or "sheeples"?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Have as many sheeples as you want, Perry the Platypus, I can always make more! (laughs)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, wait, wait! Stop flocking towards me! You're not supposed to flock in such a spherical manner!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ow! Mom... Ow! I'm... Ow! Jeremy... Ow! On the way... Ow! Are building... Ow! Croquet... Ow!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Huh, this is behavior we've never seen before.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ow!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Uh, you okay there, hon?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, I mean, it's cool. I got this, though. Jeremy and I are working on his Perry film project. Also, the boys have a project you should see.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, did you say you were doing a Perry movie? This I have to see. I'm on my way. (She drives off.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? J-Jeremy?!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (coughs) Oh, do all platypi emit smoke like this?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, my sheep! My yarn! My inator!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (grunting) Now, now, how is this supposed to put anyone to sleep?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, I see. Oh, I see. You're re-dehydrating them. Okay, good. But wait, but you missed this ball!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, all's "wool" that ends "wool".

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, a little help? Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom'll be here any minute. (She runs back toward the backyard door.) I can do it all! I'm a multitasking master! Ugh. Actually, I think this multitasking thing is overrated. (sits on the couch) It's too many taskings.

Name: The gang
Dialog: Croquet Y-8! YEAH!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Croquet just needed a few well-timed portals and pyrotechnics. Who knew?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (screams and points upward) Sudden sheep! And they're flocking this way!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Wow, that's a lotta sheeples!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Seeing as there are 34 sheep in the circumference, if we calculate the sheep radius and multiplied by y divided by 3πr², you would get... (falls asleep on the ground, snoring.)

Name: Ferb
Dialog: 589 sheep. (He too falls asleep.)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, I think we got some great footage. Awwww...

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: And finally, after a very exotic day, our monotreme takes a moment to not do much. Grabbing a well-earned cuddle with everyone's favorite hard-working assistant/producer/girlfriend. Oh! Gotta charge my phone!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (in her sleep) Yeah, Perry does this all the time...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (in her sleep) Yeah. You said it, Perry... (wakes up, pets Perry) There there you are, Perry.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Two cutie-patooties! (opens the door to the empty backyard) All right, kids. Everybody in for some snacks.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Mrs. Flynn-Fletcher, you wanna see the footage of Perry?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Ooh, absolutely! Come on, kids! And somebody wake up Baljeet.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Aah! I'm up, I'm up, I'm up!

Name: Farmer's Wife
Dialog: I can't believe you bought an entire sheep farm and didn't think to get any sheep?

Name: Farmer
Dialog: Oh, I ordered some.

Name: Farmer
Dialog: No, not those. They're being delivered this afternoon.

Name: Farmer's Wife
Dialog: (happily) Oh!
